mission_name: ASAC-6 Emergency Civilian Colony Site Activation

scenario.trigger: The colony ship is damaged on arrival in the target planet system. Its degraded orbital life support can protect the remaining 100 people for approximately one year, forcing a surface landing on simulation day 360.
scenario.deployment: The damaged ship immediately sends six astronauts and twenty-six uncrewed cargo landers to the surface. The cargo contains crated, non-operational cores, machines, consumables and spares rather than a functioning city.
scenario.crew_task: The six astronauts must survey, extract local bulk resources, fabricate field-grade parts, assemble the landed cores, connect utilities, proof-test every system and sustain a thirty-day acceptance run before the other 100 people descend.

population.description: The damaged colony ship sends six astronauts to activate the surface site while 100 people remain aboard on degraded orbital life support. The six remain after the forced day-360 landing, so readiness covers 106 occupants; the arriving group is not treated as a second construction crew during preparation.

advance_crew_consumables.notes: Packaged 360-day abort-and-survival water covers 2.5 L/person/day habitat turnover, a planned 1.0 L/person/day EVA increment, the lander OGS net water loss and a 15% contingency/packaging margin (rounded to 10,000 L). Recycling and commissioned ISRU extend margin. These consumables never contribute to the 106-person colony readiness contract.

advance_crew_power.notes: The lander's deployed 18 kW solar array charges its 120 kWh battery but does not count toward colony readiness. A finite 6 kW / 288 kWh fuel-cell reserve starts only to protect the final 20% battery reserve; it is not a hidden continuous generator.

production_policy.local_manufacturing_scope: all local civil works and shielding plus the final approximately fifteen percent of standard truss, pipe, cable, pressure, fastener and integration stock; the field shop also covers rework and replacement demand
production_policy.delivered_field_stock_basis: Eighty-five percent of the worst-planet standard assembly BOM is landed as finite, non-operational, locally reproducible parts. This removes an implausible from-ore critical path without providing a ready structure or any readiness credit.
production_policy.rule: Delivered-only flight-qualified cores are finite serialized cargo and can never be gathered, refined or recreated by the field shop. Empty stock makes dependent construction physically infeasible.
production_policy.readiness_rule: Crated cores provide zero readiness until local civil work, integration, proof testing and commissioning are complete.

cargo_architecture.notes: Cargo is predeployed as finite serialized subassemblies, not an operational city. Every credited asset still requires local bulk material, transport, supervised assembly, hookups, proof testing and commissioning.

crew_lander_architecture.notes: The six-person crew lander payload is audited separately from the twenty-six uncrewed 100 t cargo landers. Vehicle dry mass and descent propellant are outside rated delivered payload.

crew_surface_mobility.basis: The nominal gait is calibrated to NASA suited traverse measurements and is reduced at runtime by gravity, terrain, visibility, load and physiology. A learned surge is permitted only inside a projected route-end reserve envelope and increases metabolic demand through the same physiology model.

automation.basis: The delivered enclosed cells use qualified closed-loop recipe controls and interlocks. A crew operator loads and verifies a bounded program, the machine executes the unchanged physical batch duration without continuous attendance, and a qualified operator unloads and inspects the result before inventory credit. Materials and full batch energy remain committed exactly once at start.

delivered_industry.notes: Two induction furnaces, two hot-work cells and three enclosed multi-process CNC/clean-assembly cells are separate physical machines. One machine ID can run only one batch at a time. The third CNC closes the one-year fabrication critical path while remaining inside the 26-lander's audited payload ceiling.

electrical_copper_stock.notes: Includes fourteen feedstock units for a fifth utility vault if surveyed pipe length exceeds the four-vault port-based plan. Wire and harness fabrication, installation and testing remain local work.

preintegrated_cea_module_segment.notes: Four independently restrained, transportable pressure/CEA segments form one 1,000 m2 greenhouse. No landed item exceeds the 35 t surface transporter deck limit or a 100 t cargo-lander payload.

integrated_habitat_storm_vault_liner.notes: One transportable water/polyethylene shielding liner is integrated into each twelve-person habitat; the nine liners replace three duplicate stand-alone pressure shelters at the same total delivered mass.

qualified_composite_resin_pack.notes: Prequalified low-outgassing thermoset resin and hardener for the limited field-made composite-panel fraction; it is not synthesized from planetary carbon. Includes six packs for local fabrication of the fifth utility vault's integration parts.

structural_truss_section.notes: This is 85% of the direct 106-person mission truss BOM. The landed forges form and weld the remaining share from local iron while preserving a bounded one-year critical path.

metal_pipe.notes: Approximately 85% of the 5,868 pressure-tube units directly required by four three-circuit utility vaults and the full 106-person capacity build is delivered as inspected prefab stock; the remaining direct share and downstream subassembly demand are made by the landed shop.

excavator.design_basis: Autonomous paired bucket-wheel excavation and haul unit; RASSOR-derived digging head on a dedicated battery haul carrier
excavator.hard_rock_attachment: replaceable low-reaction percussive ripper and jaw-crusher head

assembly_robot.notes: Robots move and hold sub-500 kg standardized components, deploy blankets and place shielding. They cannot excavate, move multi-tonne prefab segments, or commission pressure, ECLSS, power or landing systems without an on-site crew member.

cargo_transporter.design_basis: Low-speed autonomous modular platform transporter dedicated to landed pallets and pressure-module segments; it cannot excavate, assemble, inspect or commission structures
cargo_transporter.notes: Payloads are discrete restrained modules. The transporter performs several conserved trips for a greenhouse or solar field; no astronaut backpack or assembly robot is treated as a heavy hauler.
